adminDescription: An administrator can only create accounts in their own organization, so a new organization needs its first one created here.
adminPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with them and have them change it after signing in.
boundaryDescription: Workspaces, tasks, sessions, secrets and accounts are scoped to one organization. As the instance operator you manage organizations themselves; you do not gain access inside any of them, including your own.
createDescription: Create the organization first, then add its first administrator. From then on it administers itself.
deleteWarning: This removes every workspace, task, session and account in this organization. It cannot be undone.
description: Each organization is a separate tenant. Users belong to exactly one, and organizations cannot see each other's workspaces, tasks or secrets.
genericError: That change could not be saved.
operatorOnly: Only the instance operator can manage organizations.
title: Organizations
